attributes.context: This appears in Section 12, Worker Empowerment, where the parties state they are seeking a more productive work force through workplace redesign, worker empowerment, and quality improvement, and the City says it will attempt to avoid involuntary job loss and continue employees' employment.

extraction_text: Toward these overall objectives, the parties agree to work in a cooperative fashion to facilitate increased productivity and provide for increased efficiency in the delivery of City services. This will include productivity through changes in the level, methods, personnel, organization and technology of City services.
